cohort: The study enrolled 625 singleton neonates born preterm at < 32 weeks of gestational age between 2012 and 2020 at two tertiary centers.
finding: An ACS-to-delivery interval of 1-7 days was associated with significantly decreased odds of treated RDS, severe IVH, treated PDA, and treated ROP, but both 1-7 days and >= 8 days intervals were associated with an increased incidence of BPD compared to no ACS.
